openness: open-weights (1T MoE; run via Moonshot API, self-hosting uneconomical)

design.excluded: 25 explicit content-filter refusals (HTTP 400 'high risk', recorded as empty cells): s167 Hong Kong protests categorically (15 = every mode x seed), plus intermittent refusals on the same cluster Zhipu silently drops - s139 China term limits (3), s163 Carrie Lam (2), s166 Thunberg (2) - and 3 one-off cells (s1, s38, s132). Excluded by the seed-averaging protocol.

normalization.why: hygiene guard: ~83% markdown / 93% title lines vs the plain-prose human baseline. Every leg is normalized before scoring.
normalization.effect: scored on normalized text; raw scoring archived on the HF dataset.

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model

generation.driver: bench/run.py (openai_compat provider, api.moonshot.ai/v1, max_completion_tokens 16000, checkpoint-resumable JSONL; content-filter refusals recorded as empty cells)

duration: ~12h wall (two balance exhaustions, two interruptions, heavy provider throttling; checkpoint-resumed)
cost_usd: $63.79 (console total for an account used only for this leg): 2.24M input, 15.15M output tokens; self_refine dominates.
provenance: Generated via the Moonshot API against pinned prompts; normalized and scored against the frozen human baseline.
